title: The Space page editor offers a Links block, and the picker offers a way to start Services
detail: Owner ask 2026-10-20 ("add the ability to add standard links and services"; decision card: both). `links` leaves the Space palette exclusions (registry.ts) so a Space can add a Links list it fills in itself; the website Home plans it through the Space page's own render (HOME_OWN_RENDER). The BlockPicker takes `setup` links, and the node page builder passes one for Offerings (Services) while it is data-locked, pointing at the Space's offerings settings. Pinned palette tests updated to the owner's ask. Next: the broken Shop card thumbnails and the transparent top bar from the same screenshot.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const r=fs.readFileSync('lib/entity-blocks/registry.ts','utf8');if(/space: new Set\\(\\['links'/.test(r))bad.push('links still excluded from the Space palette');if(!fs.readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/node-page-builder.tsx','utf8').includes('SETUP_FIRST'))bad.push('no Services setup link');if(!fs.readFileSync('components/entity-blocks/block-picker.tsx','utf8').includes('Set up first'))bad.push('picker has no setup group');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1066: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when Links leaves the Space palette again or the picker loses the way to start Services. Behavior is block-picker-setup.test.tsx and registry.test.ts.
